The '''Lotho Minor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Wazta sector/Legends|Wazta sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lotho Minor/Legends|Lotho Minor]].<ref name="Twitter" />
